_comment: Seeded once by scripts/new-project.sh. Setup, dry runs and the kickoff beads every project starts with.

beads.title: Onboard teammates: clone, bootstrap beads, bdh :init
beads.description: Each teammate follows ONBOARDING.md and gets a working coordinated workspace before the project starts.
beads.acceptance: Test: bdh :status on any machine lists every teammate's agents, and each teammate can bdh dolt pull and see these beads.

beads.title: Dry run: two machines, claims, locks, chat, mail, escalate
beads.description: Run the team dry-run checklist in ONBOARDING.md on a throwaway branch. Pin the bdh version that passes and note token use per agent-hour.
beads.acceptance: Test: every item of the team dry-run checklist in ONBOARDING.md passes, including both worktree checks, and git fsck is clean in every clone.

beads.title: Dry run: one night container claims a night-ok bead and merges into night
beads.description: Follow night/DRY_RUN.md: fill night/night.env, run the preflight, then night/launch.sh 1 against the night test bead. Confirms bdh :init works non-interactively with BEADHUB_API_KEY and bd bootstrap works over HTTPS.
beads.acceptance: Test: the night test bead's PR is merged into night by night-1, the bead is closed, and the loop stops by itself when no night-ok beads remain.

beads.title: DRY: make test fails if a secret file is tracked by git
beads.description: Night dry-run bead; day agents leave it for the night container. Small, real and stack-independent: add tests/test_no_secrets.sh that fails with one ERROR: line naming the file if git tracks .beadhub, anything under .aw/, night/night.env, or any .env or .env.* file other than .env.example. Merges into the night branch only.
beads.acceptance: tests/test_no_secrets.sh passes under make test and make test-fast; after git add -f of an empty .env it fails with an ERROR: line naming .env, and passes again once that file is unstaged.

beads.title: Kickoff: choose stack and boot the app skeleton with one passing test
beads.description: Hour 0. Pick the stack for the brief, scaffold the app, and add a first test so make test runs something real.
beads.acceptance: make test runs at least one real suite locally and in CI; PROGRESS.md 'Current state' filled in.

beads.title: Kickoff: write contracts/ (types, API schema, stubs) and the lane backlog
beads.description: First two hours, coordinator, using the /kickoff skill. Shared types and API schema in contracts/, stub implementations, and beads under an hour each with lane labels and night-ok where a test fully verifies them.
beads.acceptance: contracts/ committed; each lane has at least 5 ready beads that each name their test; bdh ready shows them.

beads.title: Deploy pipeline: main deploys to a public demo URL
beads.description: Every merge to main redeploys the demo so the team always has a working URL.
beads.acceptance: Test: a merge to main shows up at the demo URL within a few minutes; URL recorded in PROGRESS.md.

beads.title: Demo script and pitch outline
beads.description: Click path for the demo plus a 3-minute pitch outline in DEMO.md; revisit before the feature freeze.
beads.acceptance: Test: DEMO.md has the click path and pitch outline, and the team has rehearsed it once end to end.
